version.author: Michal MaXyM Bartak
version.changelog: The script now installs to Scripts/MXM Scripts/MXM_ListOfInstrumentsAndEffects/ instead of Scripts/MXM Scripts/Various/, so the installed tree matches the repository. ReaPack moves the file for you, but REAPER identifies an action by its path: toolbar buttons, keyboard shortcuts and custom actions bound to the old location must be pointed at the new one after updating.

version.name: 3.0.0beta1
version.author: Michal MaXyM Bartak
version.changelog: - Requires ReaImGui 0.10 or later. - Added: FX on media items; those on inactive takes are listed as offline/inactive. - Added: Input FX section, with record input FX on every track. - Added: FX inside containers, followed to any depth (REAPER 7.06 or later). - Added: About dialog (the ⓘ button). - Added: the report opens with the REAPER version. - Changed: window rebuilt on ReaImGui; sharp on HiDPI displays, and resizable. - Fixed: Markdown tables line up with a long heading and with accented names. - Fixed: the report follows the project tab you are looking at.
